claim: The ligase ribozyme system concatenates short RNA fragments into long chains.

claim: The formation of coacervate microdroplets with the ligase ribozyme and poly(L-lysine) enhances ribozyme rate and yield.

claim: Droplets containing active ribozyme sequences resist growth.

claim: Droplets containing active ribozyme sequences exhibit reduced transfer of RNA between droplets when compared to controls containing inactive sequences.
